seoTitle: How to Hide Active Status on Instagram (iPhone & Android)
metaDescription: Turn off the "Active now" green dot on Instagram so others can't see when you're online, on both iPhone and Android.
intro: That green dot and "Active now" label next to your name tells everyone when you're online in Instagram DMs. This guide shows how to turn off your activity status so your online presence stays private, on both iPhone and Android.

steps.heading: Open your profile
steps.body: Tap your profile icon in the bottom right of the Instagram app.

steps.heading: Go to Settings and Privacy
steps.body: Tap the three-line menu in the top right corner, then open Settings and Privacy.

steps.heading: Find Show Activity Status
steps.body: Search for "Show activity status" or navigate to Messages and story replies to find the setting.

steps.heading: Turn off the toggle
steps.body: Tap the toggle switch next to Show Activity Status to turn it off — once it turns gray, your activity status is hidden from others.

faq.question: Does turning off activity status hide it for everyone?
faq.answer: Yes, once disabled, other users won't see the green dot or "Active now" label next to your name.

faq.question: Does this setting work the same on iPhone and Android?
faq.answer: Yes, the Show Activity Status setting works the same way across both platforms.

faq.question: Will I still be able to see when others are active?
faq.answer: Typically, turning off your own activity status also means you won't see others' activity status, since it works both ways.

faq.question: Can I turn activity status back on later?
faq.answer: Yes, you can return to the same setting at any time and toggle it back on.
